_steering_note: NL PROMOTE/RETIRE STEERING over the gap pipeline (Wave 2). The human steers the agent's SelfConcern backlog in plain chat: 'Work on the <content> gap.' / 'Drop the <content> gap.'. VERBS ARE GRAPH DATA (the comprehend_instruction v2.0.0 pattern): each steering verb is a held Concept{name:<verb>, instruction_route:'steer_promote'|'steer_retire'} seeded below; the rules match a Mention of the turn resolving (intent's rule_mention_resolves_to_concept) to a route-carrying Concept -- no in-body verb list, teach-extensible at runtime. WHICH concern the turn names is decided graph-natively by CONTENT-WORD OVERLAP: a non-stopword Mention of the turn whose text occurs inside a noted SelfConcern's `content` (StringIndexOf >= 0 -- the graph reading its own filed gap text against the turn's own tokens). Exactly ONE concern is picked per turn via the retire_duplicate_gap Argmin idiom (the survivor is Argmin over the matching noted concerns from a fixed snapshot; the rule fires only for that binding), so a turn never batch-promotes several gaps or mints several replies. THE HUMAN GATE IS PRESERVED: steer_promote_concern only marks the concern `promote_requested=1.0` -- the DAEMON hook (_steer_tick) mechanically executes the EXISTING human-gated promote_self_concern on what the rule marked, and only interlocutor utterances (`from=='interlocutor'`) can mark it. steer_retire_concern mirrors gap_awareness's retire_duplicate_gap effects exactly (status='retired' + del_edge has_self_concern). AMBIGUITY FLOOR: when a steering verb + gap-noun fire but NO noted concern's content overlaps the turn, steer_clarify_no_match replies honestly that it couldn't tell which gap was meant and mints NOTHING (no marker, no retire). All three rules require a gap-NOUN mention (gap/concern/limitation/... -- held Concepts) so an ordinary sentence that happens to contain 'work'/'drop' never steers, and require the turn be instruction-shaped (comp_kind=='instruction' OR the boundary-classified 'request' speech act on the Message's has_speech_act edge -- a datum the adapter already writes, needed because the POS layer tags sentence-initial 'work'/'focus'/'drop' as nouns so comp_kind misses those imperatives; that POS mis-tag is the documented Python-layer blind spot). Every rule sets comprehended=1.0 on the Message it claims, so note_unhandled_instruction_gap never files a spurious gap for a steered turn. ANAPHORA ('work on that gap') is NOT wired: a bare demonstrative has no content-word overlap, so it lands on the clarify floor -- the honest, documented fallback (wiring it through current-topic tracking is a detour; the clarify floor names the fix: ask 'what gaps do you have' and name one). || v2.0.0 (tranche 15): WHICH concern the turn names is decided by QUALIA, not content-word overlap -- see scripts/gen_steer_qualia_match.py. || v2.1.0 (tranche 17): the steering aperture also resolves lexical:definition qualia -- see scripts/gen_steer_aperture_definition.py.
